mass.rationale: Conservative constant loaded mass; not independently measured.

thrust.rationale: Shared total force budget interpreting ambiguous reported 80 kN.

verticalThrust.rationale: Assumed vertical allocation; coupled to total force cap.

lateralThrust.rationale: Assumed lateral allocation; coupled to total force cap.

impulse.rationale: Bounded useful impulse; not derived from tank volume.

exhaustVelocity.rationale: Effective force-to-gas conversion, no tank thermodynamics.

reserve.rationale: Mandatory margin remaining at completion / correction approval; cannot be waived.

futureReserve.rationale: Product-policy allocation protected only by reserve-first; not safety percentage.

latency.rationale: Combined sensing / decision delay; response split not modeled.

maxLoad.rationale: Assumed point-mass occupant limit, no restraint validation.

maxJerk.rationale: Within-flight derivative bound; contact-transition jerk unresolved.

brake.rationale: Ground deceleration cap; dry-road assumption, not measured Roadster result.

bodyHeight.rationale: Assumed body height; z denotes bottom above road.

buffer.rationale: Default analysis uncertainty margin; overlap metrics use zero extra buffer.

laneWidth.rationale: Synthetic geometry, not Michigan design-standard claim.

dt.rationale: Fixed physics step; replay snapshots every 0.1 s.

syntheticScenario.class: All synthetic scenario / behavior / numerical assumptions. Not calibrated observations.

interchangeScenario.destinationCondition: Must be on Exit 17 connector, not just beyond x=500
interchangeScenario.bridgeTraffic: 24 vehicles, independent seeded constant-speed flow at 20–22 m/s; 80 m initial longitudinal spacing per lane
interchangeScenario.groundTraffic: 20 vehicles, same delayed IDM assumptions as baseline; connector y follows rampY(x)
interchangeScenario.limits: Attitude, jet footprint, real sensors and public-road permission unresolved.

suddenBrakingScenario.category: Synthetic scenario / behavior assumptions, not measured Roadster or driver behavior
suddenBrakingScenario.egoBrake: Configured brake, baseline 7.5 m/s² after configured response latency
suddenBrakingScenario.leadMotion: Continuous finite-deceleration trajectory; no teleport or instantly stopped insertion
suddenBrakingScenario.flightForecast: Script-conditioned exact lead braking path; no sensor uncertainty. Same predictor in compared aerial labels.
suddenBrakingScenario.adjacentTraffic: 14 seeded constant-speed cars, 65 m nominal spacing with 0–12 m jitter; speeds 20–23 m/s; no clearing for flight
suddenBrakingScenario.steering: Two three-second 3.7 m lateral profiles, acceleration and swept-corridor screen only; not executed branches
suddenBrakingScenario.limitation: A rejected flight does not imply ground collision avoidance. No real-world rescue guarantee.

elevatedHighwayScenario.profile: Quintic Hermite boundary-value curve per axis; north velocity 22→0 m/s, east 0→22 m/s, endpoint accelerations zero
elevatedHighwayScenario.forceScreen: Use shared total force and vertical bounds; conservatively apply existing 18 kN lateral bound to total horizontal force. No new longitudinal nozzle allocation is assumed.
elevatedHighwayScenario.traffic: Ten independently seeded constant-speed elevated cars, 20–23 m/s, 65 m spacing; sixteen adjacent northbound cars, 21–23 m/s, 80 m spacing
elevatedHighwayScenario.admission: Always denied in this version because validated 90° yaw/nozzle control is absent, in addition to any force, deck or traffic failure
elevatedHighwayScenario.actualMotion: Continues north on ground; proposed dashed path is never counted as flown

priorUseScenario.purpose: Completed optional flight depletes the resources before a later braking hazard. Ground braking remains a viable safety comparator; retained aerial capability is not assumed necessary for survival.

brakingTrajectorySearch.classification: Synthetic engineering assumption; not a Tesla specification
brakingTrajectorySearch.selection: First candidate passing force, resource, swept traffic and recovery checks; if none pass retain the first rejected candidate for inspection
brakingTrajectorySearch.scope: Sudden-braking emergency requests; optional flight remains 4.6 s
